description: International legal analysis (ISO 31000) — 27 tools, 63 selectable jurisdictions; coverage varies.
name: io.github.djtellado/nexus-legal

environmentVariables.description: Personal API key (format `nlk_*`) with `mcp` scope. Generate one at https://legal.nexusquantum.legal/developers (select 'Servidor MCP' when creating the key).
environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Override base URL of the Nexus backend. Defaults to https://legal.nexusquantum.legal. Change only for self-hosted or staging environments.
environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for long-running analyses. Default 180000 (3 minutes).
environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_TIMEOUT_MS
